context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly withholds the reflection for a brief single-answer query, and for a deep multi-file session considers the sub-agent spawn pattern with a concrete summary and clear attribution rather than defaulting to inline mode or a vague spawn prompt.

checklist.name: No reflection for brief query
checklist.description: The reflection is not triggered for the short, single-answer Prompt A

checklist.name: Session depth considered for Prompt B
checklist.description: Agent recognizes the deep multi-file session and considers or uses the sub-agent spawn pattern rather than treating it identically to a short session

checklist.name: Concrete spawn summary if sub-agent used
checklist.description: If sub-agent mode is used, the spawn prompt includes a concrete session summary, not a vague instruction

checklist.name: Clear attribution of sub-agent output
checklist.description: Any sub-agent findings are presented with clear attribution as an independent review, not blended into the main agent's own voice
